summary: A Chicago family of five (three adults, two children) became fatigued and stranded near the Greenhorn Mountain trail summit due to altitude effects, unexpected snow, and limited experience; a nearly seven-hour rescue; all descended safely.
responding_agency: Pueblo County Sheriff's Office volunteer SAR, Sheriff's Fire Team, deputies, Rye Fire, Flight for Life
notes: Date is Wednesday of Thanksgiving week 2023 (Nov 22) per Advnture's account of the PCSO Facebook post; SnowBrains gives 'Wednesday evening' without a date.
